target_customer: Data and engineering teams at software companies that run production databases and a cloud data warehouse
problem: Warehouses are loaded every few hours or overnight, so analytics and AI features see stale data. Artie streams row level changes from production databases to warehouses in near real time.
business_model: Usage based managed SaaS for change data capture, plus managed Kafka and enterprise BYOC tier
product_category: Real time data replication and change data capture

founders.name: Jacqueline Cheong
founders.background_notes: Co-founder with her husband Robin Tang per a yespress profile.

founders.name: Robin Tang
founders.background_notes: Software engineer with distributed systems background per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Reading database logs, handling merges, backfills and schema changes at scale needs distributed systems skill, but Debezium and Kafka gave a standard base to build on.

defensibility.rationale: Pipelines in production create some lock in, but open source Debezium and managed alternatives made the core capability copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Fivetran and others added CDC and streaming features over time per vendor comparison pages. No acquisition of Artie found through 2026-01.

market_need_then: Batch ETL left warehouses hours behind production. Artie's customers include ClickUp, Substack and Alloy, which the company says process over 700 billion rows a year through it.

branding.domain_note: Uses artie.com; the earlier address artie.so appears in a directory, and when the .com was acquired is not stated.

identity.logo: Elephant based identity, per the title of a linked post The Elephant Stays
identity.visual_style: Full redesign in April 2025 aimed at enterprise clarity
identity.voice_and_tone: Thoughtful, ambitious, detail obsessed and a little crazy, per the company's own brand reset post

branding.brand_signature: Elephant mascot (inferred from a post title, not described in the fetched text)

rebrands.why: Branding lagged the enterprise grade product and had accumulated design debt, per the company's post

branding.community_and_virality: A Show HN launch for the self serve product exists; no merch or fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: The company invests in brand and explains it publicly, and customer logos like Substack and ClickUp appear on the site, but evidence of pull beyond engineers is thin.

outcome_analysis: Artie is active with named customers such as ClickUp, Substack and Alloy, a $3.3M seed in February 2024 and a $12M Series A led by Standard Capital in January 2026. Real time data needs for AI features are a tailwind and the product has clear demand, while competition from Fivetran, Airbyte and open source Debezium keeps defensibility modest. Final outcome is not yet known.
